# Wence Benierem Tongol

> Full-stack developer in Pampanga, Philippines, working mainly in TypeScript.
> Builds Next.js and React interfaces, the APIs that serve them, the PostgreSQL
> databases behind both, and the integrations that connect applications to AI
> tools. Also goes by Weywey Tongol.

This is the personal portfolio of Wence Benierem Tongol (also known as Weywey
Tongol, or Weywey). It is a single page; the links below are sections of it.

The site is a client-rendered React application. A complete plain-HTML summary
of every section is present in the initial response inside `#seo-fallback`, so
the content is readable without executing JavaScript.

Currently a CRM Developer Associate at Manentia Enterprise Support PH Inc.,
building business automation: Zoho CRM workflows that turn records into
finished client documents, Model Context Protocol connectors on Microsoft
Azure, and REST integrations secured with OAuth 2.0.

- [Projects](https://wencetongol.vercel.app/#projects): Six selected projects, with the stack and the problem each solved.
- [Stack](https://wencetongol.vercel.app/#skills): Technologies grouped by category — languages, frameworks, databases, platforms and APIs, tooling.
- [Background](https://wencetongol.vercel.app/#education): Education and certifications.
- [Contact](https://wencetongol.vercel.app/#contact): Email and profiles.

## Projects

- JB FIX System (2026): Private-bank order-routing connector speaking FIX 4.4.
- Enterprise MCP Connectors (2026): Identity-aware Model Context Protocol integrations on Microsoft Azure — MWC Mail Search, MWC Purview eDiscovery, BexioMCP.
- Financial Planning Report Automation (2026): CRM-driven document generation in Zoho.
- Investment Proposal Automation (2026): Portfolio proposals generated from CRM holdings data.
- [BarberHouse](https://github.com/codew3y/barber-shop-system) (2026): Barbershop booking website.
- VistaVR: Virtual reality eye testing application.

## Technical stack

JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS,
PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Microsoft Azure, OAuth 2.0, Microsoft
Graph, Model Context Protocol, REST APIs, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, Postman,
PowerShell.

## Background

Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Pampanga State University,
2022 to 2026.
